reviews.review:
I had a surprisingly great time with this one. It feels like a love letter to old-school platformers but with its own modern flavor. The world is super fun to explore one moment you’re jumping around rooftops, the next you’re diving into underground areas, and every location has its own vibe. The animations really stood out to me too; the movement looks smooth and natural in a way you don’t often see in small indie projects.

What I enjoyed the most is how alive the city feels. There’s humor everywhere, little details tucked into the backgrounds, and a nice mix of stylish and gritty areas that make the journey feel fresh. Even when I died (a lot), I kept wanting to push forward just to see what the next level would look like.

If you enjoy 2D platformers with charm, personality, and a unique artistic touch, this one is definitely worth trying. It’s a passionate project and you can feel the heart that went into it.
